## Why it matters

handrit.is brings together manuscript holdings from major Icelandic and related collections and supports browsing, search, and institution-level discovery.

For researchers working on medieval and modern Nordic history, it offers a reliable starting point for locating manuscript witnesses and accessing digitized copies where available.
